All DJ’s are not the same; location, culture, and experience alone prove this, not to mention all of the countless other reasons!

Real talk—
the way you end the year is usually how you start the next one.

The gym isn’t just about weight or aesthetics.
It’s a place for discipline, stress relief, confidence, and rebuilding trust with your body.

As a massage therapist, I see it all the time:
people don’t quit because they’re weak — they quit because their body never gets supported.

Movement + recovery = longevity.

So yeah… thank you to the person who introduced me to the gym.
That one decision shifted more than just my workouts.

If this feels like a message for someone you know, share it with them.
We’re not waiting until January.

How about rounding out the year with a big win? 🔥 CWA Local 1031 members and other CWAers in NJ have been fighting to make sure that workers at New Jersey City University are protected as the university merges with Kean University and advocating to amendments to legislation overseeing the merger. 

CWAers sent over 12,000 emails to their state legislators, spoke with State leaders at last week’s Lobby Day, and Local 1031 President Kathy Hernandez testified before multiple legislative committees over the past several weeks, and this week we WON:
✅ No “working test period” for NJCU workers that would have put them on probation
✅ NJCU workers retain their seniority 
✅ One year moratorium on layoffs following the merger

A veces creemos que el regalo está afuera,
pero en realidad empieza adentro.
Cuando nos damos permiso de sentir, de equivocarnos, de mirarnos con honestidad,
algo se ordena.

Y desde ahí, el amor se vuelve más real.
Más paciente. Más sincero.

No se trata de familias perfectas,
sino de estar, de escucharnos, de intentarlo otra vez.

Si hoy puedo regalar algo,
es mi presencia.
Porque desde ahí, el amor sí alcanza para todos.
